'''Gorruth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who worked as a security guard during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Gorruth worked for the [[Comet Broom Service]] on [[Artom Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that was located in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. After the two [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] co-owners of the Service were murdered by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]], Gorruth was part of the security team that discovered their bodies. He told the Service's administrative department to stop any [[Starship/Legends|starships]] from landing or taking off from Artom Station, until someone official could be sent to investigate the murders.
